title: Multi-stage export with authorised-operator residual route
description: Primary route: exposed service-password reference, service identity, service-support workstation, internal support application, excessive privilege, unrestricted export application and synthetic care archive. Separate residual precondition: an already compromised or malicious authorised support actor misuses a required export role. Privileged reauthentication caps the final operation, but the selected controls do not completely remove this legitimate-permission route.
recommendation: Combine authentication and entitlement controls with oversight of legitimate exports; retain the authorised-operator residual route in the explanation.
